notes.title: Sonic Expo Atlanta, 2025!
notes.content: [p]Sonic Expo Atlanta is [b]a three-day fan event celebrating all things Sonic the Hedgehog and SEGA, happening from August 15th to 17th at the Courtland Grand Hotel in Atlanta[/b]. The event features a variety of activities, including tournaments, an artist alley, a cosplay contest, and an art gallery fundraiser. Attendees can also meet voice actors, artists, writers, and content creators, as well as enjoy a rave and karaoke. [/p][p][/p][p]Spicy Gyro Games will have a booth in the game room. We will be showing classics like Polyroll and Panic Porcupine, upcoming title "Polyroll Pocket", as well as a couple yet un-announced games in early alpha![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42055531/67e85b9f5a85f6564fd2e16c1d89cce159a09b8c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: An All-New Polyroll Adventure: Polyroll Pocket!
notes.content:
Polyroll is back for an all new adventure! This time he'll go where no Polyroll has gone before: Space! Kaiser Kiwi has landed on the moon with a diabolical plan to wipe out the Polyrolls. You'll need to reclaim the stolen batteries, power up your rocket ship, and blast off for the final confrontation!

[list]
[*] Polyroll Returns: More platforming action packed with a plethora of secrets to uncover!

[*] 24 Stages: Jump, Spin, Fly, and even pilot a submarine in a pocket-sized quest!

[*] Talk of the town: Shop, chat, and discover the entrances to 6 unique worlds.

[*] Battle the Bosses: Reclaim the stolen power sources to your rocket from Kiwi's goons!

[*] 8-bit action: Inspired by classic 90s handheld adventures 
[/list]

Be sure to wishlist Polyroll Pocket now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2436130/Polyroll_Pocket/

notes.title: Panic Porcupine 1.07 Update!
notes.content:
We've released a new version of Panic Porcupine with several quality of life improvements.

* Full Options Menu is now accessible from within levels/map screens
* Menu system improvements
* New tutorial videos that give hints on tricky sections in first world
* Switching to Portuguese in the menu works now
* Performance improvements
* Various small level polish improvements
* Minor bug fixes
